additional_info.body:
Dear Emre-abi,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
: Y2/RD 300000004017
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
0YGPz6
Problem Description
: FailsafeMode_Active due to missing KF12
Troubleshooting
:
It seems that the KF12 is not in the network. It can be something related to the Ethernet cable or KF12 is faulty.
Please proceed to check if the EcoG has the input voltage necessary to work and if there are any LEDs light up.
I recommend you to bring a new KF12 to site. Please send me a message in Teams or email to align when I can support you remotely if needed.
Please bring me evidence if you can do the troubleshooting yourself. Pics and videos.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0379365
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
